data.subject: Local Ledger four-week fund pilot
data.body:
Hi,

GRAHAM CAPITAL WEALTH MANAGEMENT's most recent 13F for the period ended June 30, 2026 shows positions in SFBC, CPBI, and CLST.

On September 29, 2026, ELME received a delisting or listing-standard notice in an 8-K Item 3.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/104894/000010489426000117/elme-20260928.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
